description:
## Destination

defk ready for a first Hex release: Linux evidence (the suite on x86-64 and aarch64, one Linux measurement run), a stability promise for the kernel subset and the runtime contract, and the expansion candidates from docs/verdict.md ('Where defk could grow') triaged.

## Notes

- Opened by the accepted verdict (defk-sgw.6, 2026-10-14): the go/no-go rule's outcome is go; the decision taken on it is to keep developing and improving defk, and not to publish on Hex until the two gates above hold.
- First ticket: defk-a1p (Linux suite and measurement run).
- Stub: the map's design (decisions, ordering, what the stability promise covers) is its own session.
- The deferred epics (defk-52v, defk-n4r, defk-sve, defk-ulk, defk-96f) and the open support epics stay as they are until this map triages them; they do not reopen automatically.
- Known evidence gap carried over: the snapshot records no spread (best of five only); the next snapshot should add it to Defk.Bench.report/1.
title: Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release
